v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

text.la: Cantántibus órganis, * Cæcília Dómino decantábat, dicens: Fiat cor meum immaculátum, ut non confúndar.
text.en: The musicians played, and Cecilia sang unto the Lord, * saying: Let my heart be undefiled, that I be not ashamed.

text.la: Valeriánus * in cubículo Cæcíliam cum Angelo orántem invénit.
text.en: Valerian found Cecilia praying in her chamber, * and with her the Angel.

text.la: Cæcília * fámula tua, Dómine, quasi apis tibi argumentósa desérvit.
text.en: Busy like a bee, * O Lord, did thine handmaiden Cecilia serve thee.

text.la: Benedíco te, * Pater Dómini mei Iesu Christi, quia per Fílium tuum ignis exstínctus est a látere meo.
text.en: I bless thee, O Father of my Lord Jesus Christ, * that through thy Son the fire is gone out round about me.

text.la: Triduánas * a Dómino popósci indúcias, ut domum meam ecclésiam consecrárem.
text.en: I have asked the Lord for three days, * that I may consecrate my house as a Church.

text.la: Fratres: Qui gloriátur, in Dómino gloriétur. Non enim qui seípsum comméndat, ille probátus est; sed quem Deus comméndat.
text.en: Brothers: But he that glorieth, let him glory in the Lord. For not he who commendeth himself, is approved, but he, whom God commendeth.

v.la: Diffúsa est grátia in lábiis tuis.
v.en: Grace is poured into thy lips.

r.la: Proptérea benedíxit te Deus in ætérnum.
r.en: Therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.

text.la: Virgo gloriósa * semper Evangélium Christi gerébat in péctore suo, et non diébus neque nóctibus a collóquiis divínis et oratióne cessábat.
text.en: The glorious maiden * carried the Gospel of Christ always in her breast, and meditated therein day and night talking with God and praying.

text.la: Deus, qui nos ánnua beátæ Cæcíliæ Vírginis et Mártyris tuæ solemnitáte lætíficas: da, ut, quam venerámur offício, étiam piæ conversatiónis sequámur exémplo.
text.en: O God, Who year by year dost gladden thy people by the solemn feast of thy blessed Virgin and Martyr Cecilia, grant unto us, we beseech thee, not only devoutly to observe the same, but also to follow after the pattern of her godly conversation.
